body:
Addressed: Added the requested before and after toolbar screenshots to the PR body.

- Both images show the same document and pointer over the bottom toolbar's Frame button. The after image shows the hover help.
- The captures use the real `ShellUi` layout and `View3D` GPU renderer. Painted-text checks confirm that the tooltip is absent before and present after.
- The images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at commit `b64d161b1769014892619b7b6ae736e3dbb55514`.
- Pin: `every_bottom_toolbar_button_explains_its_action_on_hover`. Removing hover registration made this test fail. Restoring registration made all six toolbar tests pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all nine steps passed. Tests: 1297 passed, seven ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

PR head: `af1f247e624ed5033629e5a2ebc667d5516b8826` (unchanged). This finding required images and PR text only. No source files changed.

Please re-review PR #2783.

Addressed: The requested before and after viewport toolbar screenshots are linked in the PR body.

- Before: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/b64d161b1769014892619b7b6ae736e3dbb55514/2783/before.png
- After: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/b64d161b1769014892619b7b6ae736e3dbb55514/2783/after.png

Both links return the committed PNG files. The images show the same scene and pointer position. The after image shows Frame hover help. The files exist only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The requested links were already present when this pass started.

Fresh verification:
- Pin: `every_bottom_toolbar_button_explains_its_action_on_hover`.
- Mutation: removing hover registration made the pin fail. Restoring the source made all six toolbar tests pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all nine steps passed. Tests: 1297 passed, seven ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

Head: `af1f247e624ed5033629e5a2ebc667d5516b8826` (unchanged). The plain push reported everything up to date. No source changes were needed. The PR remains a draft. Review labels remain unchanged.

Please re-review PR #2783.

The maintainer ordered a clear-out of the PRs with `conflicts` or `needs-rework`. The coordinator session of NeoTech merged `main` into this branch.

- New head: `e3cd4c86a927014544f2e9846be598bdc425080c`.
- Merge commit: `e3cd4c86a`.
- Conflicted file `crates/ui/src/egui_app/viewport_bar_tests.rs`: both sides added tests at the end. Resolution: kept both sides.
- Semantic conflict: `main` added the `Nav::Display` button (#2818). The exhaustive `tooltip()` match had no arm for it. The merge adds the Display arm in `viewport_bar.rs`, the Display row in the tooltip pin, and changes "12 buttons" to "13 buttons" in `docs/decisions/2776-toolbar-tooltips.md`.
- Delta class: DELTA.
- No separate repair commit.

Gate: a trial merge of `main` at `ee91ac3e5`, this head and other PRs passed the batch tier on Windows: 998 steps, 2 failed. The two failed steps belong to other PRs of that trial merge. An agent that did not write the change ran it.

Still owed: a new after-screenshot of the 13-button bar.

Ready for a re-check.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Addressed: Updated the after screenshot to show all 13 toolbar buttons, including Display, with Frame hover help.

- The PR body links the new PNG. It exists only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `1a5f79d774ebaf0e9978f2dafe05b19bc6c4ac79`.
- The temporary capture test used the real ShellUi and View3D renderer. It checked 13 buttons, Display, and the painted Frame tooltip.
- Pin: `every_bottom_toolbar_button_explains_its_action_on_hover`. Removing hover registration made it fail for all 13 buttons. After restoration, all nine toolbar tests passed.
- Merged `upstream/main` because the PR has the `conflicts` label. The merge needed no manual changes.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: nine steps passed; 1370 tests passed; seven ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Temporary capture code was removed. No screenshots or review evidence were committed to this PR branch.

New head: `e0d21442fdce5c35b5f56df51afec64017b0649a`.

Please re-review PR #2783.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e0d21442fdce5c35b5f56df51afec64017b0649a -->
Review at head e0d21442f (delta review of the refresh; earlier clean review at af1f247e6 by mkinney).

The refresh is a hand-resolved merge of main (`e3cd4c86a`) plus a clean merge of main (`e0d21442f`). I read the remerge-diff of the hand merge:
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/viewport_bar_tests.rs`: both sides kept. The PR's `hover_text` helper and the two tooltip tests stay, and main's `expanded_bar_contains_controls_without_touching_buttons` and `typed_move_and_turn_respect_units_and_refuse_bad_input` stay.
- `Nav::Display` (main, #2818) is a semantic conflict, resolved correctly: the Display tooltip arm added, the Display row added to the pin test, and the decision file says 13 buttons.
- The second merge is empty by remerge-diff: main's changes went in as they are.

Nothing from main was dropped. The screenshots are met: the body carries a before image and an after image that uses this head and shows the 13-button bar with the Frame hover help ("Frame all - Fit the whole document in the view."). I checked the after image: the tooltip shows.

Verdict: clean. The label state is not changed by this review; the stale `conflicts` label is settled at merge time (`cargo xtask merge-plan --delta`).

Ready and merge: the coordinator flags head e0d21442f ready and merges it. Class: SAME after the gated refresh e3cd4c86a (mkinney's merge of upstream main 08697d3c4; the remerge-diff is empty). Review: SlaveSession's clean review on e0d21442f (comment 7051059238). Gate: the stack-1 batch tier on e3cd4c86a (see the earlier coordinator comment) and mkinney's quick gate on e0d21442f (nine steps, 1370 passed). The PR merges cleanly with main d66400b78. The labels needs-rework and conflicts are stale for this head; the coordinator removes them.
